title: Patrapoda
author: Ahimanikya Satapathy

paragraphs.text: Patrapoda begins with a parcel, but the heat still matters. In Lopa’s home account, fish and mushrooms share a mustard paste; the tied leaf parcels go on a greased griddle or an open fire. The bhapa method instead puts seasoned ingredients in a closed box for steaming. These are distinct preparations.

NDTV’s recipe credited to Chef Senapati of Toshali Sands uses fish pieces with ginger, garlic, cumin, mustard and red chillies. The marinated fish is tied inside banana leaf and placed on coal. Here the wrapping and the heat source are both specified.
The Rayagada photograph identifies fish patrapoda; it does not establish either recipe’s exact ingredients.

notes.text: Chef Senapati, Toshali Sands, Machcha Patropoda (Fish Wrapped in Banana Leaf), NDTV Food.
